issue.body:
I have been using this with home-manager and nimi for a few months.

```nix
  imports = [
    flake-inputs.nimi.homeModules.default
  ];

  nimi.backrest = {
    services.backrest = {
      imports = [ pkgs.backrest.services.default ];
      backrest.dataDir = "${config.home.homeDirectory}/.local/share/backrest";
      backrest.configPath = "${config.home.homeDirectory}/.config/backrest/config.json";
    };
    settings.restart.mode = "up-to-count";
    settings.restart.time = 2000;
  };
```

There is an open PR which adds it for regular nixos module https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/422093, the pr is halted a bit, so I am opening this.

Currently I use `DyanmicUser = true;` and give the backrest service no capabilities, so it is not going to backup root or other user owned directories.
I will take some time to incorporate that PR's contributions into this and add @M0ustach3 as co author.

- [x] basic nixos test
- [ ] other changes from nixos module pr
- [ ] more things noted in comments below

pull_request.title: backrest.services.default: init

review_comments.body: This could be fragile, maybe an update script can auto generate this.
We can test backrest e2e. will be a follow-up pr if it is troublesome to get it working soon.

If the command is not running on host then we should use `pkgs` of the machine config. so I might move restic to `environment.systemPackages`. (`hostPkgs` when running using `subprocess.run` or `os.system`)
We could have a vm template like https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/330708 does, to test backrest without having to test it during the development of this module on a real host.

Could belong in `backrestWrapped`. And some of the args passed as env vars. (modular services doesn't have environment variables support yet, this module could be refactored later on when it gets implemented)
Test that `extraPackages` work with a simple hook in the nixos test.
review_comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -0,0 +1,138 @@
+# Non-module dependencies (`importApply`)
+{
+  bash,
+  symlinkJoin,
+  makeBinaryWrapper,
+}:
+
+# Service module
+{
+  lib,
+  config,
+  options,
+  ...
+}:
+let
+  inherit (lib)
+    getExe
+    literalExpression
+    mkOption
+    types
+    ;
+  cfg = config.backrest;
+
+  backrestWrapped = symlinkJoin {
+    name = "backrest-wrapped";
+    paths = [ cfg.package ];
+    nativeBuildInputs = [ makeBinaryWrapper ];
+    postBuild = ''
+      wrapProgram $out/bin/backrest \
+        ${
+          lib.optionalString (cfg.extraPackages != [ ]) "--prefix PATH : ${lib.makeBinPath cfg.extraPackages}"
